name: znf
description: Zenify workspace skill kit — cook/fix/ground/scout/ship + forked engine

track.title: Dev track
track.description: Record time, tokens and ship quality of cook/fix/hotfix/ship runs in this workspace. Runs zenify feature track on|off.

githubIssues.title: GitHub issues
githubIssues.description: Opt-in GitHub issues feature of this workspace. Runs zenify feature github.issues on|off.

trackPane.title: Track pane
trackPane.description: auto opens the track pane on a cook/fix/hotfix/ship prompt or skill; command opens it only with /track-pane; off never opens it and does not register /track-pane.

tips.title: Status line tips
tips.description: Show contextual tips (backlog, estimate, over est, PRs waiting) at the end of the status line. The onboard tip and the track off line always show.

reviewer.title: Reviewer
reviewer.description: The engine znf:review uses. Runs zenify reviewer set agent|codex; applies to new sessions.
